note: Below 1.000 by design, and lower than the 0.701 measured before the fetch unit existed: with ideal (zero-latency) memory the prefetch buffer's registered response is pure overhead. The same core wins at every non-zero latency - see results/experiments.md. A pipeline also loses cycles to load-use and CSR-use interlocks and the two-instruction flush on every taken branch; it buys those back with a shorter critical path, so the comparison that matters is IPC x Fmax, and only under realistic memory.
